title: Reseller Discount on Second-Key Certificate Orders
content:
**Reseller desk note — SSL/TLS Certificates, second-key orders.**

A second-key order is the further subscription of the same certificate product, for the same common name and the same number of extra names as an active subscription the customer already holds, that a customer buys because another server needs its own key. The second-key discount percentage of such an order follows the tier recorded on the customer's account in **Harborline Customer Accounts**:

| Tier recorded on the customer's Harborline account | Second-key discount percentage |
|---|---|
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | the SSL certificate discount percentage the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for Platinum |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | the SSL certificate discount percentage the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for Gold |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | the SSL certificate discount percentage the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for Silver |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | the SSL certificate discount percentage the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for Bronze |
| any other tier (for example Harborline Personal Account or Harborline Business Account) | no second-key discount |

**What the percentage reduces.** The second-key discount percentage reduces only the certificate price component of the second-key order, that is, the product's price for the years of the second-key term. It never reduces the extra names of the order: whatever the extra names are billed, they are billed without this percentage.

**Points of judgement.**

- The tier that counts is the one recorded on the customer's Harborline account, as the account record shows it, not a tier the customer describes.
- A Harborline Reseller Silver account ordering a second key for a certificate carrying extra names has the Silver percentage taken off the certificate price component only; the extra-names amount is unchanged by it.
- A Harborline Business Account takes no second-key discount on any component.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Suppose a reseller tier whose SSL certificate discount percentage were 12 percent (an illustrative figure, not a tier value), a certificate price component of USD 211.40 and an extra-names component of USD 96.15. The certificate price component is reduced by 12 percent to USD 186.032; the extra-names component stays USD 96.15.
